# @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit

> TypeScript library that renders A4 pathology lab reports for MGPL Diagnostics (Maa Gayatri Path Lab) as React HTML and as pure Node.js PDFs (react-pdf, no browser). Two designs (`sidebar` Navy Sidebar default, `classic` Word replica), two variants (`header` with letterhead, `non-header` for pre-printed paper), 31 test templates + 7 profiles, automatic H/L flags, barcode + QR. Works in Next.js, React and Node backends.

Key facts for agents:
- Build a report with `buildReport(patient, [{ template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10.8" } }])`; template ids are in `TEMPLATES`, each lists its result keys in `.fields`.
- Render HTML with `<LabReport report variant="header" />` from the main entry (pure component, RSC-safe); PDF with `renderReportPdf({ report, variant })` from `/pdf`; standalone HTML with `renderReportHtml` from `/server` (Node only).
- HTML needs `/report-fonts` + `/report-assets` served: run `npx mgpl-report-assets public`. PDF/server need nothing (assets ship in the package).
- In Next.js add `serverExternalPackages: ["@react-pdf/renderer", "@resvg/resvg-js"]` and use `runtime = "nodejs"` for PDF routes.
- Geometry lives in `src/sidebar/layout.ts` / `src/layout.ts`; both renderers share it plus a row-height model, so HTML and PDF paginate identically. Never change one renderer only.
- react-pdf drops text that overflows its box and crashes on missing glyphs; run `npm run smoke` (checks fit, glyphs, PDF text, page parity) after any change.
- Money/ranges: use ASCII (`>=`, `Rs.`); fonts lack `≥` and `₹`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install (GitHub Packages or git), quick start for Next.js, React, Node, printing
- [API reference](docs/api.md): every export, type, template id and option
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, file map, invariants, react-pdf gotchas, how to add templates

## Source entry points

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): browser-safe exports
- [src/pdf/index.ts](src/pdf/index.ts): Node PDF export
- [src/server.ts](src/server.ts): Node HTML string export
- [src/templates/index.ts](src/templates/index.ts): TEMPLATES, PROFILES, buildReport
- [src/lab.ts](src/lab.ts): lab branding (MGPL_LAB)
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): data model
